sources.title: My IMMORTAL Shen Build (All Lanes: Top/Mid/Jungle/Bot)

passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.text: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.text: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.text: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.text: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

spells.name: Stand United
spells.text: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

damage.value: Shen deals sustained magic damage through three Q-empowered basic attacks within eight seconds.

archetype.value: Shen is a defensive tank who shields allies, blocks attacks, and taunts enemies.

axis.value: Shen can farm for experience in hard matchups and use Q to gain a shield when threatened.

winCondition.value: Shen wins by staying alive, denying farm and experience, and using his ultimate to help secure assists or kills.

spikes.why: Shen gains three basic attacks with bonus range and magic damage.
Shen becomes strongest as he farms toward his build.
Shen can dash and taunt more often than at its 18-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Shen players make a mistake when they chase kills instead of farming and staying alive.
Shen wastes Spirit’s Refuge when his spirit blade is not near those he means to protect.
